classes.title: Inline macro expansion at an invocation site
classes.truthful: The span the compiler assigned to the tokens that carry the finding. A block written at the invocation belongs to the invocation line; a token written in the macro body belongs to the definition line. When the record carries an expansion origin, emit it as expansion metadata; the invocation line alone is a complete source location for an invocation-site token.

classes.title: macro_rules! or derive output (generated items)
classes.truthful: For a macro_rules! body the compiler attributes generated tokens to the definition line, with an expansion origin only where the record supplies one. Each invocation is a separate instantiation with its own generated name and no distinct source line. A derive-generated item has no source file or line of its own; the attribute's line locates the input, not the generated code.
unavailable: a per-instantiation source line
the expansion origin when unrecorded

classes.title: Monomorphised generic instance
classes.truthful: For source, the generic definition line is the shared body and is not any instance's own line. For a binary finding, the mangled or demangled instantiation symbol and its offset are the location; the generic definition is background, never the instance's address.
unavailable: a per-instantiation source line
the type arguments unless the symbol is demangled
a distinct source extent for each instance

classes.title: Trait-object or dynamic dispatch call
classes.truthful: The call site the record carries, with the static target set it establishes. A trait method's definition is shared by every dynamic call and is not the call's location. In a binary, the containing function's offset plus the call-site offset is the whole location.
unavailable: the runtime target unless the record resolves it
the receiver's concrete type
the callee's source line
the trait definition's applicability to this call

classes.title: #[no_mangle] C ABI export
classes.truthful: For source, the Rust declaration line is truthful for the export declaration. For a binary finding, the exported symbol name is the identity and the DSO plus address is the location. The export declaration line is never the address of the machine code.

classes.title: Indirect call through a function pointer
classes.truthful: The DSO, the containing function's offset and the offset of the instruction that performs the indirect call. If the record resolves the pointer's provenance, the provenance is emitted verbatim; the callee is not a location the record establishes unless it names one.

classes.title: Inlined function in optimised code
classes.truthful: The enclosing out-of-line symbol and the offset of the inlined code inside it. The inlined body has no symbol and no call site of its own. A source line for the body is truthful as source text; it does not become a binary location.
unavailable: a symbol for the inlined function

classes.title: Function reached only through a binary symbol
classes.truthful: The DSO, the exported symbol name and the address or byte offset the record carries. Where the record also carries an extent, emit both lengths equally. A source definition may be cited as background but is not the binary occurrence's location, and symbol presence establishes no reachability.
unavailable: a source line for the binary occurrence
the call path

an extent when the record records none
